card.name: Ends of RDA and DRI abbreviations
card.fires_on: The last piece of dietary intake abbreviations such as RDA (the DA) and DRI (the RI), and the word recommended before dose. It appears in vitamin and nutrient intake text.

modes.label: RDA / DRI endings
modes.description: Closing piece of the abbreviation RDA or DRI when discussing vitamin intake levels.
modes.example: those over 50 years of age should meet the R<<DA>> by eating foods fortified with B12

modes.label: Recommended before dose
modes.description: The word recommended just before dose in daily or weekly dose statements.
modes.example: add Selenious Acid to provide total daily<< recommended>> dose of 2 mcg/kg/day
